note: FNS 753.2 specifies when QC reviewers should exclude variances from error calculations in expedited service cases — specifically that the exclusion normally applies to the first month only, but extends to the second month when a household applies after the 15th and receives expedited service with waived verification for both months. This is entirely QC audit methodology (how to score review findings), not caseworker policy. The underlying worker-facing concepts (expedited service eligibility, verification postponement) are covered in the OLG under 'Expedited Benefits' and 'Verifications at Application', but the variance exclusion rule itself has no worker-facing equivalent and would not belong in the OLG.
